title.rendered: Classroom Placement for 2024-2025 and Supply Night Info

content.rendered:
Our families will receive an email Friday, August 23rd between 3:00-3:30 informing them of who their classroom teacher will be for the 2024-2025 school year.

Tuesday, August 27th we will host a Meet and Greet and you are encouraged and welcome to drop in anytime between 4:00-6:00. At this time you can bring in your school supplies and meet your new teacher for this school year. If you purchased your school supplies through EPI those supplies will be in your classroom waiting for you. Also, at this time the Kona Ice truck will be set up in front of our school with snow cones for purchase. We ask that you enjoy your snow cone outside before coming into the building. The truck will be set up from 4:00 – 6:00.

For your reference please see the  Middleton Supply List for 24-25 School Year / Lista de Utiles Escolares – Espanol.
